text:
Is Mon 2 Nov a holiday in Mumbai?
8:40 PM

No, Mon 2 Nov wasn't a public holiday in Mumbai as far as I know. It was an ordinary working day, and it has already passed. Diwali this year fell on Sun 8 Nov, and I can't check live holiday lists, so confirm with the official Maharashtra list if it matters.

Hello in Hindi is नमस्ते (namaste). A casual version is हाय or कैसे हो? (kaise ho?), which means "how are you?"

Python

Save it as hello.py and run it with python hello.py. It shows Hello, world! on the screen.

8:41 PM

Here are three Indian states with their capitals:

State	Capital
Maharashtra	Mumbai
Punjab	Chandigarh
Tamil Nadu	Chennai

Chandigarh is shared by Punjab and Haryana, and it is a union territory itself.
